This has some real potential to explain some of the most strange world-ending scenarios (both natural/human-caused and Foundation-caused). I’m currently in the process of drafting up some scenarios while trying to adhere with what’s been in the document, and I’ll be putting it on my sandbox once it’s finished. Might even include some that have already been mentioned in other SCPs to tie it in a little ;)

However I think the logs should perhaps be on another page linked from here with some clearance. Either way very interesting concept.

item.content:encoded:
Overall it is a good article. There is mystery, but not confusion, the skip is well understood and is interesting without need for many OTT powers.

But there are two things that bother me. The first is a lack of a log. This isn't just an interesting read on itself as described, also this book begs for a sample to better drive home the mood of the thing.

The second are the addendums. They seem too out of context, and I fairly doubt an O5 would ever ask the utility of the Foundation keeping this in containment.
